ALTER TABLE sites ADD COLUMN version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1

CREATE TABLE site_corrections (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, site_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_site_correction_version UNIQUE (site_id, version), FOREIGN KEY(site_id) REFERENCES sites (id), FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id))
CREATE FUNCTION protect_site_corrections() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Site correction history is immutable'; END; $$
CREATE TRIGGER site_corrections_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON site_corrections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_site_corrections()
